title: A Claude session on the Windows host records a run of both suites
goal: kb/_self/reports/windows-run.md records the commit, the host and the results of tests.py and stress_test.py as run by a Claude session on the Windows host, and a test fails when the record names a commit that is not an ancestor of HEAD or lacks either suite's result

trigger.when: a Claude session runs in a clone on the Windows host and can run tests.py and stress_test.py there

notes: Its run needs a Claude session in a clone on the Windows host; the trigger holds it until one exists (fire it with backlog.py fire ST-pg5jyebo), and the same session can run ST-xjb4wykm “Defender's cost on test scratch files is measured and settled by the operator”.
